text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One night, while I'm organizing some files in my office…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I was hoping to borrow you for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Do you remember at the end of summer camp how I said there was something I wanted to do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I… I want to issue a challenge to someone. Could you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober leads us through the campus until we finally meet…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You're already here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. I came a bit early to watch the sunset.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now then…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What is it you wished to say to me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, I…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to thank you for everything you've done for me up until now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You've guided me through so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: When I had just entered Tracen and was too flustered by the male teachers, you were the one to help me study…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And when I was worried about the differences between myself and other Mejiros like McQueen and Ryan, you were the one to give me an ideal to chase after.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You came to watch my debut race and reassured me when I was overcome with fear before the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You knocked some sense into me when I felt as if I was going to lose the battle against myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, I…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to become "Mejiro Dober."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even if I have people I admire, I'm not going to compare myself to them. I'm going to become a unique light in this world like none other.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Will you please accept this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she says this, Mejiro Dober holds out a single flower to Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course… I would be glad to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a smile, Air Groove reaches out…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And accepts the yellow carnation from Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: In the language of flowers, yellow carnations mean "jealousy." Usually, people avoid using such a message…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But there are some among us who purposefully choose to gift this flower to others.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: For example, to their incredible and accomplished mother…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Or to a role model we admire. With that gift we declare…

text_block_list.name: Dober and Groove
text_block_list.text: I will surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I see you remembered.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I haven't forgotten a single thing you've taught me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: After all, I idolize you. You are my ideal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Which means you are also the person I want to surpass the most!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to surpass you, Air Groove, and create my own path as Mejiro Dober!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting for you at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …What a remarkable challenge that was.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm so relieved she accepted it…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thanks for accompanying me, Trainer.
choice_data_list: No problem, but why did you want me there?
No problem, but why did you want me there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I mean…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You've guided me through a lot too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I wanted to declare my intentions for the future in front of both you and Air Groove today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove understood that. That's why she didn't say anything even when she noticed you standing there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haha! What are you thanking me for? You're so weird!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I will never forget her face at that moment, shining in the light of the setting sun…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The preliminary to the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, the Fuchu Umamusume Stakes, is right around the corner!
